_description: Known chokepoint systems with historical gatecamp data. Supplements algorithmic pipe/hub detection with community knowledge of persistently dangerous systems.
_source: Community knowledge, validated against DOTLAN and historical killboard data

systems.name: Uedama
systems.reason: Mandatory crossing between Gallente and Caldari highsec. Primary highsec ganking system.
safe_alternatives: Route via Sivala (longer but avoids Uedama)
Use webbing alt for faster warp-to-warp

systems.name: Ahbazon
systems.reason: Sole lowsec gate between Domain and Genesis highsec pipe. Unavoidable for Amarr-Gallente travel.
safe_alternatives: Route through highsec via Amarr-Jita corridor (much longer)

systems.name: Rancer
systems.reason: Lowsec pipe system between Sinq Laison and Metropolis. Notorious for persistent gatecamps.

systems.name: Tama
systems.reason: FW lowsec pipe between Caldari and Gallente space. Heavy FW and pirate traffic.

systems.name: Amamake
systems.reason: FW lowsec hub near Minmatar-Amarr warzone. Historic pirate staging system.
safe_alternatives: Scout ahead or travel in fleet

systems.name: Niarja
systems.reason: Former highsec shortcut between Amarr and Jita. Now Pochven — inaccessible via normal stargates.
safe_alternatives: Niarja is inaccessible without Triglavian standings or filaments
Use the Amarr-Jita route via Madirmilire/Sivala instead
Route adds ~15 jumps compared to pre-invasion shortcut

systems.name: Hek
systems.reason: Minmatar trade hub on lowsec border. Gate to Eszur is a known camp spot.
safe_alternatives: Avoid Eszur gate unless prepared for lowsec
